name: @w6w-apps/mailjet
description: Send transactional email via Mailjet's v3.1 Send API and manage contacts, lists, templates, senders, and statistics.

w6w.longDescription:
Mailjet sends transactional email and manages the contacts, lists and templates it draws on. Send a single message, a templated one, or a batch — with Mailjet reporting success or failure per recipient rather than one status for the whole call — and read back message logs and delivery statistics afterward.

Contacts and lists are manageable end to end: create and update contacts, add or remove them from a list, and bulk-load a set of contacts asynchronously with a job to poll for completion. Listing templates and senders rounds out what's needed to build a send with confidence that the sender address is actually validated.

A fit for transactional email from an app or workflow — order confirmations, notifications, password resets — and for keeping a contact list in sync as people opt in or out elsewhere. Campaign authoring stays in Mailjet's own interface; this app is for sending and reading data around it, not building newsletters.
